raw.scope: Point estimates for one fixed target policy, not a confidence bound or safe deployment decision. Requires correct logging propensities, action/reward consistency, relevant context, target support and appropriate sampling assumptions. Reward predictions must be trained independently or cross-fitted for usual DR theory; schema cannot verify this. SNIPS is finite-sample biased. Clipping can bias IPS/DR and changes the estimator. ESS is descriptive, not a validity certificate. Support checks apply only to supplied observed contexts; no hidden-confounding or unseen-context check.

audit.scope: Fixed supplied policy, reward predictions and observed rows. Deleting a row does not refit. Breakpoints are positive observed raw weights, not recommended caps. Between breakpoints IPS/DR are affine in cap; SNIPS and ESS are generally not. No variance, confidence, identification, safe deployment, policy selection or causal validity certificate.
